digo: Mkuta manena; Mlunga njira; Njira mbiri
digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, V, VI and ch. 4

teaser.en: Every branch forks into exactly two, so regularly that Digo speakers identify it by its branching alone.
teaser.sw: Kila tawi hugawanyika kuwa mawili hasa, kwa utaratibu kiasi kwamba Wadigo huutambua kwa mpangilio wa matawi yake peke yake.
teaser.dg: Chila panda inaganyika kukala panda mbiri tu, sawa-sawa sana, hata atu anaogomba Chidigo nkuumanya kpwa vira pandaze zinavyoganyika bahi.

summary.en: Mkuta manena, also called njira mbiri, is a shrub or scrambler with a strictly regular, forking branching pattern. Digo speakers recognise it by that pattern, and one of its names means 'two ways'.
summary.sw: Mkuta manena, unaoitwa pia njira mbiri, ni kichaka au mmea unaotambaa juu ya mingine wenye mpangilio wa matawi unaogawanyika kwa utaratibu kamili. Wadigo huutambua kwa mpangilio huo, na mojawapo ya majina yake maana yake ni 'njia mbili'.
summary.dg: *Mkuta manena*, unaoihwa piya *njira mbiri*, ni chitsaka au mmea unaoambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina, ambao pandaze zinaganyika kukala mbiri-mbiri sawa-sawa chila wakati. Atu anaogomba Chidigo nkuumanya kpwa mpangilio uho, na dzina rimwenga kahi ya madzinage rina mana ya 'njira mbiri'.

about.en: *Mkuta manena* is a shrub or woody scrambler. Its most distinctive feature is its branching: at each point the stem divides into two, very regularly, so the whole plant forks again and again. Pakia gives it as an example of a plant identified by its 'habit', and says that people recognise it from its leaves and stem. The leaves are opposite and smooth, and the plant has small yellowish tubular flowers.
about.sw: *Mkuta manena* ni kichaka au mmea wa mbao unaotambaa juu ya mimea mingine. Sifa yake kuu ni jinsi matawi yake yanavyoota: kila mahali shina hugawanyika kuwa mawili, kwa utaratibu kamili, kwa hiyo mmea mzima hujigawa tena na tena. Pakia anautaja kama mfano wa mmea unaotambuliwa kwa 'umbo lake la ukuaji', na anasema watu huutambua kwa majani na shina lake. Majani yake huota kwa jozi zinazotazamana na ni laini, na mmea una maua madogo ya rangi ya manjano hafifu yenye umbo la mrija.
about.dg: *Mkuta manena* ni chitsaka, au mmea wenye nyama za muhi unaoambala dzulu ya mimea yanjina. Alamaye kulu zaidi ni vira pandaze zinavyoganyika: chila phatu kolo rinaganyika kukala seemu mbiri, sawa-sawa sana, kpwa hivyo mmea wosi unaganyika kukala mbiri tsona na tsona. Pakia anaulavya dza mfwano wa mmea unaomanyikana kpwa umbo ra mmea wosi (*habit*), na anagomba kukala atu nkuumanya kpwa makodzage na kolore. Makodza ganamera mairi-mairi ganayolengana na ni laini, na mmea una maruwa madide ga umbo ra mrija ga rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu.

where.en: It grows in coastal bush and forest edges in East Africa and further south.
where.sw: Unaota katika vichaka vya pwani na pembezoni mwa misitu Afrika Mashariki na kuelekea kusini.
where.dg: Unamera weruni wa pwani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka Afrika Mashariki, na kusini zaidi.

uses.en: Pakia records no Digo use. Elsewhere in southern Africa its roots are used in traditional medicine, and the plant is known to contain toxic compounds.
uses.sw: Pakia haandiki matumizi yoyote miongoni mwa Wadigo. Katika sehemu nyingine za kusini mwa Afrika mizizi yake hutumika katika dawa za asili, na mmea huu unajulikana kuwa na kemikali zenye sumu.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi ga Adigo. Phatu phanjina kpwenye seemu za kusini za Afrika, miziye nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji, na inamanyikana kukala mmea uhu una kemikali za sumu.

culture.en: Pakia sets *njira mbiri* beside *mfidzofidzo* (*Garcinia livingstonei*), which branches in threes. Both are identified by their fixed branching pattern.
culture.sw: Pakia anaiweka *njira mbiri* sambamba na *mfidzofidzo* (*Garcinia livingstonei*), ambao matawi yake hugawanyika matatu matatu. Mimea yote miwili hutambuliwa kwa mpangilio wake maalum wa matawi.
culture.dg: Pakia anauika *njira mbiri* kanda-kanda ya *mfidzofidzo* (*Garcinia livingstonei*), ambao pandaze zinaganyika kukala tahu-tahu. Mimea yosi miri nkumanyikana kpwa mpangilio wa panda zao usiogaluka.

names.en: Pakia records three names. *Njira mbiri* means 'two ways': the plant branches twice (*mbiri*) at each point, and the branches are the *njira*, 'ways' or 'paths'. *Mlunga njira* and *mkuta manena* are given without explanation. *Mkuta manena* is close to *chikuta manena*, the name of *Rourea orientalis*. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anaandika majina matatu. *Njira mbiri* maana yake ni 'njia mbili': mmea hugawanyika mara mbili (*mbiri*) kila mahali, na matawi ndiyo *njira*, yaani 'njia'. *Mlunga njira* na *mkuta manena* yametolewa bila maelezo. *Mkuta manena* linakaribiana na *chikuta manena*, jina la *Rourea orientalis*. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mahahu. Mana ya *njira mbiri* ni 'njira mbiri': chila phatu mmea unaganyika kukala panda mbiri (*mbiri*), na panda izo ndizo *njira*, 'njira'. *Mlunga njira* na *mkuta manena* ganaandikpwa bila kuelezwa. *Mkuta manena* rinahalana na *chikuta manena*, dzina ra *Rourea orientalis*. Maandiko tagana dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

reason.dg: Rourea orientalis, dzinare rinahalana sana na hiri
